title: Add audit log events for Optimize quality gate decisions and overrides
creator: Jordan Lee
description:
Background
- Optimize recommendations can apply cost-saving config changes (batching/caching/quantization). We are introducing mandatory quality evaluation gates before changes can be applied.
- Enterprise customers and Security require a traceable audit trail for: what changed, who approved it, and what the gate outcome was.

Goal
Emit first-class Audit Log events for the lifecycle of a quality gate run and any override actions so customers can export to SIEM / internal compliance tooling.

In-scope events (MVP)
1) Gate run started
- Event: optimize.quality_gate.run_started
- When: Optimize service transitions gate run -> RUNNING (after pre-gate validation passes and eval-harness trigger request is accepted)

2) Gate run completed
- Event: optimize.quality_gate.run_completed
- When: gate run reaches terminal state (PASSED | FAILED | CANCELED | ERROR)
- Must include the pass/fail decision + a short machine-readable reason code set

3) Override granted
- Event: optimize.quality_gate.override_granted
- When: an authorized approver grants a time-bound override allowing apply/promotion despite failed gate or missing gate

4) Override expired / revoked (recommended for v1; include if low lift)
- Event: optimize.quality_gate.override_expired
- Event: optimize.quality_gate.override_revoked

Non-goals / explicitly out of scope
- Logging prompt content, model outputs, or customer data payloads.
- Building the Console UI for audit log views (tracked in Console work). This ticket is about emitting events to the Audit Log stream.
- Private/on-prem automation (we should ensure schema can be reused, but implementation targets Hosted first).

Requirements / Acceptance Criteria
- All events are emitted to the standard Redwood Audit Log pipeline with correct tenant/account scoping.
- Events are emitted exactly-once per gate run transition to avoid noisy compliance exports (at-least-once delivery is OK, but producer should dedupe via stable idempotency keys).
- Event payloads contain:
  - tenant_id / account_id
  - actor (user_id, service principal) and actor_type
  - action timestamp
  - resource identifiers: route_id, model_id, current_config_version, proposed_config_version, gate_run_id
  - gating policy identifiers: policy_id, gate_tier (SMOKE | FULL), baseline_id
  - decision: PASSED/FAILED/etc. (for run_completed)
  - summary stats: metric_name list and aggregate deltas (no per-prompt artifacts)
  - links/ids to artifacts stored elsewhere (artifact_id or URL tokenized), but not the artifacts themselves
  - request correlation ids: optimize_request_id, eval_harness_job_id (when present)
- Overrides must include:
  - override_id
  - justification string (required; min length enforced)
  - expires_at
  - approver_id
  - affected capability: APPLY_TO_PROD, CANARY_PROMOTION, BOTH
- PII and secrets: strictly redact; no prompts; no raw outputs; no auth tokens.
- Backwards compatibility: If an existing manual config apply occurs without gates (legacy path), emit optimize.quality_gate.missing_or_bypassed with reason=legacy_apply (so enterprise teams can detect bypass).

Implementation notes
- Producer location: Optimize service (authoritative for gate run state machine and override records).
- Use existing auditlog client library; add new event types to schema registry with versioned payloads (v1).
- Add idempotency key per event:
  - run_started: gate_run_id + "started"
  - run_completed: gate_run_id + "completed" + terminal_state
  - override_granted: override_id + "granted"
- Emit within the same transaction boundary as state change where possible; otherwise, ensure outbox pattern is used to prevent lost events.
- Ensure RBAC: only admin/approved roles can grant overrides; event emission should include actor captured from auth context.

Testing / Verification
- Unit tests for payload construction + redaction.
- Integration test: gate run pass/fail path results in both started + completed events.
- Integration test: override path emits override_granted and includes expires_at.
- Manual verification in staging:
  - Trigger known failing suite; confirm run_completed FAILED event.
  - Grant override; confirm override_granted and apply allowed.

Rollout plan
- Behind feature flag: auditlog.optimize_quality_gates.enabled (default on for staging, off for prod until SRE signoff).
- Enable for limited prod rollout accounts (same cohort as gating enforcement) for 1 week; monitor event volume and dedupe.

Owner / Collaborators
- Owner: Michael Nguyen
- Security review: Marcus Lin
- Console consumer alignment: Felix Schneider / Chloe Martin (field naming + future UI)

Open questions
- Should rollout-controller also emit audit events for canary promotion blocked due to gate failure, or do we treat that as a separate rollout audit stream? Proposal: separate event optimize.rollout.promotion_blocked with gate_run_id reference (track separately; not required for MVP).
comments: 2025-12-02 (Michael Nguyen): Drafted event names + payload fields. Aligning with Felix/Chloe on resource identifiers (route_id vs deployment_id) so Console can link audit items to the gate run view.

2025-12-05 (Marcus Lin): Security note: payload must not include prompt text, outputs, or rubric annotations. Artifact links must be opaque ids (no presigned URLs in audit log). Add a linter/test to prevent accidental inclusion of prompt fields.
2025-12-12 (Jordan Lee): Confirmed Optimize is the source of truth for gate run state transitions; rollout controller should reference gate_run_id but not duplicate gate decision events.

2026-01-08 (Michael Nguyen): Implemented outbox emission on gate_run transitions. Added idempotency keys; auditlog consumer shows occasional duplicates during retry—dedupe appears correct downstream but keeping producer keys stable.
2026-01-22 (Felix Schneider): Request: include proposed_config_version + baseline_id in run_completed. Needed for enterprise audit exports to attribute decision to a specific diff and baseline.

2026-02-03 (Michael Nguyen): Added optimize.quality_gate.missing_or_bypassed for legacy manual apply path. Reason codes: legacy_apply, emergency_disable, system_error. Default only emitted when apply happens without a PASSED gate or valid override.

2026-02-10 (Sean Gallagher): SRE signoff: ok to enable in limited prod cohort; monitor auditlog pipeline latency and volume. If flake retries create high event volume, cap run_started emission to once per gate_run_id (already true).
2026-02-18 (Michael Nguyen): Shipped to limited prod cohort with feature flag on. Verified events arriving with correct tenant scoping and actor attribution. Marking Done.
